interface.longDescription: Use the paid Ask The W Codex plugin after install and workspace binding. Bind a paid project, then pull project context: the W Card, North Star, outcomes, decisions, and moves. Write a decision, complete a move, or push one update only when the user asks. The plugin does not capture automatically and does not upload transcripts. Examples: bind the folder you have open; pull the current project context; push a product or architecture decision when the user asks.
